mapper.select: SELECT time as MEAS_TM, alert_group_name as FAB_ID, host_name as SVR_NM, was_name as PROC_NM, IDC_NM, MEAS_VAL FROM ( SELECT to_char(sysdate, 'YYYYMMDD') as time, i.alert_group_name, i.host_name, i.was_name, ROUND(AVG(s.os_cpu_user/10),2) as os_cpu_user, ROUND(AVG(s.jvm_cpu_usage/100),2) as jvm_cpu_usage, ROUND(AVG(s.jvm_used_heap/1024),2) as jvm_used_heap, ROUND(AVG(s.os_cpu_sys/10),1) as os_cpu_sys, ROUND(AVG(s.jvm_thread_count),2) as jvm_thread_count, ROUND(AVG(s.txn_elapse/100),2) as txn_elapse FROM apmadm1.xapm_was_stat_summary s JOIN apmadm1.xapm_was_info i ON s.was_id = i.was_id WHERE s.was_id IN (SELECT was_id FROM apmadm1.xapm_was_info WHERE alert_group_name = 'M14_MCS') AND s.time >= to_date(substr(to_char(sysdate-1,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),0,8)||'090000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND s.time < to_date(substr(to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),0,8)||'090000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') GROUP BY to_char(sysdate, 'YYYYMMDD'), i.alert_group_name, i.host_name, i.was_name ) UNPIVOT ( MEAS_VAL FOR IDC_NM IN ( os_cpu_user AS 'CPU_OS', jvm_cpu_usage AS 'JVM_CPU', jvm_used_heap AS 'JVM_HEAP', os_cpu_sys AS 'CPU_USER', jvm_thread_count AS 'JVM_THREAD', txn_elapse AS 'TXN_TIME' ) ) ORDER BY time, alert_group_name, host_name, was_name, IDC_NM
